evidence: Carries the P2P label and directly alters peer-to-peer block relay by implementing BIP 332 block serving and fetching over the P2P protocol.
rationale: Implements the block serving and download mechanisms for BIP 332 (Stale Tip Relay). As described in the PR, this 'lets peers fetch the blocks behind the stale tips' and avoids unwarranted peer disconnections by using an independent best-effort schedule separate from active-chain block download.
